description: Layouts of a message's chance values and whether their object indexes are the canonical ones (docs/FAIR.md section 3). view is the message's own value (null for none): drew and i, or removed. objects are its object entities, in the order they are listed (not always the order of at): at, drew and i, removed. edited says the message has been edited. Go (internal/fair), the web chat (shared/fair/indexes.js) and the app (lib/core/fair/indexes.dart) all give ok for each.
